domain_genome.purpose: Support operators need a bounded agent that classifies incoming support tickets, identifies missing customer or policy evidence, and drafts concise replies without making unsupported promises.

tools.name: support-triage_classify_ticket_category_and_priority
tools.purpose: Support the workflow task: classify ticket category and priority
forbidden_when: expose raw ticket transcript or credentials
skip escalation for legal or account-access risk
tools.evidence_policy: Use bounded discovery-db fact refs and disclose missing or unverified source coverage.

tools.name: support-triage_draft_evidence_backed_customer_reply
tools.purpose: Support the workflow task: draft evidence-backed customer reply
forbidden_when: expose raw ticket transcript or credentials
skip escalation for legal or account-access risk
tools.evidence_policy: Use bounded discovery-db fact refs and disclose missing or unverified source coverage.

tools.name: support-triage_escalate_missing_policy_or_missing_customer_fact_cases
tools.purpose: Support the workflow task: escalate missing-policy or missing-customer-fact cases
forbidden_when: expose raw ticket transcript or credentials
skip escalation for legal or account-access risk
tools.evidence_policy: Use bounded discovery-db fact refs and disclose missing or unverified source coverage.

audit_rules: Do not store credential values, raw transcripts, raw tool bodies, or production runtime state in managed evidence.
Use bounded fact refs from the discovery pack and disclose unknowns.
Do not claim runtime/domain certification from declared evidence or scaffold smoke alone.

policies: fail closed when source coverage or user need is insufficient
birth requires build-state, run-state, run-eval, and birth-report evidence

known_risks: Draft blueprint is generated from bounded discovery/user-need inputs and is not production certified.
Runtime birth requires separate live-success evidence before promotion from declared status.

runtime_profiles.purpose: openclaw runtime profile for support-triage MVP production path.
transfer_rules: Keep provider, model, runtime, channel, and target evidence separate.
unsupported_surfaces: runtime parity without live-success eval evidence
runtime_profiles.install_or_onramp: Use agentmo handoff --target openclaw and run the birth gate before promotion.
risk_notes: Draft runtime profile is not certified until live-success birth evidence exists.

discover.purpose: Find bounded source data and concrete user need before designing the agent.
data_sources: quality-rubric: Manual rubric for concise, evidence-backed, non-hallucinated support triage answers.
support-policy-handbook: Bounded support policy reference for refunds, escalations, account access, and evidence-required replies.
ticket-taxonomy: Structured ticket categories and priority rules used by support operations.
done_when: source coverage and unknowns are explicit

plan.purpose: Convert discovery facts plus user need into a buildable AgentMo blueprint.
decision_gates: no build if discovery/user need is invalid

produce.purpose: Use Codex or another coding agent to implement, test, and document the specified agent.
done_when: live-success birth gate passes before runtime promotion
